record.question: He came before the appointed time. Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer C: Preposition. “Before” introduces the noun phrase “the appointed time”, so it is a preposition. Independent check: “Before” governs the noun phrase “the appointed time,” so it is a preposition. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/prepositions.
